name: mula-relay
description: Your own cloud copy of Mula's data, and the connector that lets Claude read and edit it. Runs on Cloudflare Workers' free plan.

APP_TOKEN.description: The password the Mula app uses to sync: at least 16 random characters. In Mula, open **More › Automation › Claude › Create a token** to make one (it's copied for you), then paste it here.

OWNER_PASSWORD.description: A password you choose (at least 8 characters). You type it once when Claude asks to connect to your relay.
